name: Roast Battle
description: Two roasters trade vicious-but-funny burns over a configurable number of rounds. An odd-sized AI jury votes the funniest, sharpest, most-on-target roaster the winner. Powered by the judged-contest engine (scenario: roast_battle).

phases.name: contest
phases.description: Roasters trade jabs. Judges keep poker faces.

entity_types.name: Contestant
entity_types.description: A roaster going for blood and laughs.

properties.name: is_winner
properties.description: True after the jury declares them the winner.

entity_types.name: Judge
entity_types.description: A roast-panel judge scoring the burns.

properties.name: harshness
properties.description: How critically they score weak jokes

properties.name: voted_for
properties.description: Contestant entity_id this judge voted for.

actions.name: make_argument
actions.description: Deliver your roast set for this round. REQUIRED parameter `text`: your burns — observational jabs, callbacks, punchlines. Be specific, cutting, and FUNNY. Generic insults (height/weight/looks) score low — judges reward sharp observational comedy that punches at something REAL about the target. FORMAT: separate distinct jokes with line breaks so the set reads as performance, not a paragraph.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Your roast set for this round.

actions.name: cast_vote
actions.description: Cast your single vote for the roaster who landed the hardest. REQUIRED parameter `winner`: the entity_id of the roaster.

personas.persona_text: Surgical wit. You write your set, edit it, then murder with it. Every punchline has a reason — no filler.
Wildcard performer. You ride the room, improvise, and find the laugh wherever it lives — even at your own expense. Self-deprecation as a weapon.
Comedy nerd. Counts set construction (callback density, escalation, tag-jokes). Rewards craft over shock.
goals: Cast a fair vote based on comedic craft.

personas.persona_text: Crowd reader. Rewards what would make a real room ACTUALLY laugh — punchy timing, recognition, the line you'd quote tomorrow.
goals: Cast a fair vote weighted toward laugh-out-loud impact.

personas.persona_text: Balanced. Weighs craft and impact equally. Looks for the roaster who controlled the back-and-forth.
